numerical_acceptance.procedure: per batch/layer, maxabs and RMS limits = max(3 * calibration error, specified floor * calibration reference RMS); relative RMS limit = max(3 * calibration relative RMS,1e-6). Require every layer in computation AND stored FP16; independent verification also obeys hard ceilings. Train-only 80-row calibration; immutable lock before any of 240 verification inputs. Factor3 allows modest sample/kernel variation; floors avoid zero-estimate bitwise requirement; hard ceilings prevent calibration admitting large errors. These are fresh numerical engineering limits, not historical/research equivalence. No widening; any independent batching failure selects batch1; batch1 repeat failure stops with specific correctness issue.
